$comment: MCP servers for https://clarkhuang.github.io. Human docs: https://clarkhuang.github.io/mcp/ (Markdown: /mcp/index.md).

servers.name: clarkhuang-site
servers.title: clarkhuang.github.io site MCP server
servers.description: Read-only tools over the site's public files: lessons, transcripts, chapters, captions, media checks, watched-progress keys, search, and contributor-style issue drafts (never files anything).

CLARKHUANG_SITE.description: Base URL or local folder to read. https://clarkhuang.github.io/staging reads staging (next-revision).

install.claude_code: claude mcp add clarkhuang-site -- uv run https://clarkhuang.github.io/mcp/clarkhuang_site_mcp.py

servers.name: gitmcp
servers.title: GitMCP for clarkhuang/clarkhuang.github.io
servers.description: Third-party remote server (GitMCP). fetch_clarkhuang_docs returns the current llms.txt; its search index can lag behind the site, and it has no lesson or issue tools.
